responsibility: Defines the RTL operand and operator predicates that the Xtensa machine description uses to select and validate instruction patterns. These predicates classify registers, non-literal memory operands, literal-pool accesses, masks, shifts, branch immediates, reload forms, TLS symbols, and especially call operands with PIC-aware section checks, giving xtensa.md and expansion code a reusable target-specific vocabulary for legal operand shapes beyond the simpler constraint letters.
